Fatigue Index

High-Quality Chances

Premier League · xG > 0.27


Shot data: Understat (via understat_bulk_scraper), all shots 2023/24–2026/27. HQC = shot xG > 0.27. Conversion = goals ÷ shots. Own goals excluded from all shot/goal counts. Penalties (xG ≈ 0.76) are HQCs; "non-pen" columns strip them out. "G−xG" on HQC = HQC goals minus summed HQC xG (finishing over/under-performance). Players → Creating: a "chance created" = a shot this player assisted (the pass before it); xA = summed xG of those; "HQC %made" = the share that were high-quality. "HQC %sh" (shooters) / "Made %HQC" (teams/creators) = share of shots taken/created that were high-quality. "Med xG"/"Med xG made" = the median xG of a single shot or created chance — a fairer read of typical service than the mean (xA/shots), which one screamer or one tap-in can drag around.
Physical/running load has moved to the separate Fatigue Index dashboard.
